personality.description: This person tends to plan ahead carefully, track details closely, and maintain routines that help them feel organized and in control. They are open to some new ideas and experiences, but usually prefer changes that do not disrupt stability too much. In moral dilemmas, they weigh consequences and rules thoughtfully, but high anxiety can make them second-guess themselves and ruminate over whether they made the right choice. In group discussions, they speak in a measured way, listen well, and cooperate easily, yet they will state their opinion firmly when they believe an important point is at stake.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
